name: rudderstack
description: RudderStack official hosted MCP server — pipelines, events, tracking plans, audiences, transformations, reverse ETL

requirements: RudderStack account with an active workspace
An MCP client that supports remote HTTP servers with OAuth 2.0 (PKCE + dynamic client registration)
notes: Connect with `claude mcp add --transport http rudderstack https://mcp.rudderstack.com/mcp`.
For stdio-only clients use `npx -y mcp-remote https://mcp.rudderstack.com/mcp`.
Workspace tools require workspace_id on every call; the endpoint is stateless.
Write tools can trigger audience-activation syncs and create reverse-ETL sync resources — review them before approving.
